title: Export upcoming visits from Jobber
status: draft: narration follows the platform's help article; check every line against the recording before narrating
sampleData: The platform's authorized demo account with sample clients only. No real names, emails, phone numbers, account ids or payment details on screen.

scenes.narration: This shows how to export your upcoming visits from Jobber.
Select Insights in the side navigation, then Reports. Under Work reports, choose Visits.
Set the date filter to the weeks ahead you want to bring in.

capture.what: Set Start within to the next 8 weeks.

scenes.narration: Click Export to CSV, and choose all columns. Jobber emails the file to you.

capture.what: Export to CSV, all columns, confirmation.

scenes.narration: Return to Selestial and upload the file you just downloaded.

capture.what: Open the email, download the CSV.
